exceptions.reason: No Base UI component imports the file. It is the module of the package entry `./internals/csp-context`, and Vase UI has no entry point for an internal module.

exceptions.title: does not render Select inline style tags when disableStyleElements is true
exceptions.reason: The case tests the style element that `Select.Popup` renders for a popup that is placed over the trigger (`alignItemWithTrigger`). Vase UI does not have that placement, so its popup renders no style element.
